Overview

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge.
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests.
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location: Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates.

Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.

She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Work closely with the Partnership Sales team to deliver sponsorship and sales objectives, identifying and pursuing high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Support the sales team research function, building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies.
  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.
  • Produce a range of materials (in collaboration with creative team) to support the sales managers throughout commercial discussions.
  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.
  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.
  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Proven experience in similar roles within sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Experience using consumer insights platforms (ex. GlobalWebIndex)
  • Exposure to media value reports and how they’re used in sponsorship
  • Familiarity with market research platforms and broader sponsorship market
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

  • Planejar e executar o desdobramento de metas estratégicas para níveis táticos e operacionais, aplicando a metodologia GPD com autonomia e visão integrada dos objetivos organizacionais.

  • Conduzir reuniões de análise crítica com gestores, apresentando diagnósticos e recomendações fundamentadas, contribuindo para decisões assertivas e melhoria dos processos.
  • Aplicar metodologias de melhoria contínua como PDCA e análise de causa raiz, estruturando planos de ação e acompanhando sua execução para garantir eficácia e sustentabilidade das soluções.
  • Apoiar as áreas na definição e revisão de metas, promovendo alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos e assegurando consistência na mensuração dos resultados.
  • Consolidar e validar resultados de metas, garantindo a integridade dos dados e a conformidade com os critérios estabelecidos, atuando como referência técnica no processo de apuração.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e apresentações executivas com clareza e objetividade, traduzindo dados em informações relevantes para diferentes níveis da organização.

Qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia, Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento sólido em metodologias de desdobramento de metas (GPD, OKR), gestão de indicadores e ferramentas de melhoria contínua como PDCA e análise de causa raiz.
  • Domínio de Excel avançado (incluindo dashboards e modelagens), Power BI e sistemas de gestão de performance.
  • Inglês intermediário para leitura de materiais técnicos e comunicação com áreas corporativas.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :) Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, onde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visam diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único! Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Operations Manager BRA (Remote)
description:
An Operations Manager plays a pivotal role in ensuring that a team’s day-to-day activities run smoothly and align with the organization’s strategic objectives. This position is responsible for overseeing operational processes , ensuring that resources—such as personnel, budgets, equipment, and time—are used as efficiently and effectively as possible. By setting and maintaining high company standards , an Operations Manager works to consistently exceed objectives, improve productivity, and foster a culture of excellence.

The role often requires coordinating between frontline employees and senior leadership , serving as a critical link to ensure that communication flows clearly in both directions. This includes translating high-level business goals into practical, actionable plans for teams, as well as escalating operational challenges to upper management when needed.

Typical duties may involve developing and optimizing workflows , managing budgets, monitoring performance metrics, and implementing process improvements to boost efficiency and quality. An Operations Manager also plays an active role in problem-solving , anticipating risks, and addressing issues before they escalation, ensuring smooth operations even under tight deadlines or high-pressure situations.

In addition, this role often includes training, mentoring, and performance evaluation to help employees prioritize tasks, meet individual and team goals, and contribute to a positive, high-performance workplace culture.

Success as an Operations Manager requires a balance of strategic thinking, strong leadership, adaptability, and excellent organizational skills , along with the ability to make data-driven decisions that drive sustainable growth and operational excellence.

title: Lead HR Generalist - Americas
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with more than 1,200 colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We are looking for a Lead HR Generalist to offer their expertise to the AMER region. It is an exciting time to join, with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life‑cycle, and partner with leadership in your region. You will have an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to interpret data trends and themes.

Location

This role will be based remotely in the AMER region.

Role entails

  • Deliver precise and compliant HR operations in a timely manner and with the highest degree of accuracy.
  • Interact closely with the Americas HR Manager and the Global Head of HR to create impact across all HR regions.
  • Be accountable for HR processes such as talent development, succession planning, performance assessments, onboarding, culture and engagement initiatives that drive a high performing team.
  • Work with managers across the business on performance management, organizational design, employee engagement, rewards and workforce planning.
  • Partner with the HRIS team to develop and refine operational processes for day‑to‑day HR administration.
  • Coach and advise people managers on the full spectrum of employee relations issues across multiple countries.
  • Partner with people managers to support the delivery of appropriate training and development programs.
  • Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region.
  • Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives.
  • Design new policies and deliver on business‑critical HR related projects globally.

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from high school and university.
  • HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business.
  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights.
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders.
  • A good balance between leading and executing; in this role you will need to be hands‑on involved in the daily HR routines.
  • Experience mentoring and developing others.
  • Strong project‑management skills with the ability to define deliverables and keep them on track.
  • Experience working in a remote‑first organization.
  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions.
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken).
  • Self‑motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results‑orientated, open‑minded and enthusiastic.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events.

Nice to have skills

  • Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes.
  • Payroll and/or benefits oversight experience.
  • Knowledge of HR systems and databases.
  • Professional HR certification(s).
  • Facilitation skills.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
O Analista Jurídico atua como parceiro estratégico das áreas de negócio da DeLuna, prevenindo riscos e viabilizando operações logísticas com segurança jurídica, celeridade e eficiência. OsRequisitos mínimos para a função são:

  • Bacharelado em Direito e OAB ativa.
  • Experiência sólida em direito empresarial/contratual e contencioso cível/trabalhista, com passagem por logística, transporte, e-commerce ou varejo com operação de distribuição.
  • Vivência com regulação do transporte (normas ANTT e correlatas), seguros de transporte (RCTR-C, RCF-DC) e gestão de sinistros.
  • Domínio de contratos B2B e atenção às regras de consumidor para B2C.
  • Noções práticas de LGPD aplicadas à logística e integração tecnológica.
  • Capacidade de negociação, escrita jurídica clara e orientação a negócios.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais.

Diferenciais desejáveis

  • Pós-graduação em Direito Empresarial, Contratos, Regulatório, Trabalhista ou Proteção de Dados.
  • Experiência com operações frigorificadas/cadeia fria e SLAs de temperatura.
  • Atuação prévia com RFPs/RFQs, licitações e contratos com marketplaces.
  • Inglês intermediário/avançado.
  • Vivência com Legal Tech, CLM e dashboards jurídicos (Power BI).

Competências comportamentais

  • Visão de negócio e mentalidade consultiva, com senso de urgência.
  • Comunicação clara e habilidade de mediação/negociação.
  • Proatividade, organização e gestão de prioridades em ambiente dinâmico.
  • Postura ética, confidencialidade e foco em compliance/ESG.
  • Colaboração com áreas multifuncionais (Operações, Comercial, Financeiro, Fiscal, RH, TI/SI).

Principais responsabilidades e atividades

1) Consultivo e Contratual

  • Elaborar, revisar e negociar contratos com clientes (embarcadores, marketplaces), fornecedores (transportadoras subcontratadas, operadores, armazéns, tecnologia) e parceiros estratégicos.
  • Padronizar minutas, SLAs, KPIs, níveis de serviço e penalidades, incluindo particularidades de:
    • Last Mile, Line Haul, cross-docking, pontos de trânsito (Transit Points) e XPts.
    • Operação de carga frigorificada (cadeia fria e controle de temperatura).
    • Entregas B2C/B2B (CDC e B2B), prazos, avarias, extravios e limitação de responsabilidade.
  • Revisar cláusulas de responsabilidade, seguro, sinistros, guarda e custódia, compliance, confidencialidade (NDA), anticorrupção, LGPD, propriedade intelectual, rescisão e mediação/arbitragem.
  • Suporte jurídico a RFPs/RFQs e licitações (públicas e privadas, incluindo pregões e contratos de adesão de marketplaces).

2) Regulação do Transporte e Compliance

  • Acompanhar e aplicar normas e resoluções vigentes da ANTT e demais órgãos competentes.
  • Orientar sobre CT-e, MDF-e, PGR (gerenciamento de riscos), tabelas de frete mínimo e documentação de transporte.
  • Suportar compliance ESG, anticorrupção (Lei 12.846/2013), concorrencial e trabalhista (incluindo particularidades do motorista profissional e relações com agregados/terceiros).
  • Implementar e atualizar políticas internas, treinar equipes (Operações, Comercial, Fiscal/Tributário, RH) e disseminar cultura de integridade.

3) LGPD e Segurança da Informação

  • Auxiliar a TI/Segurança na adequação LGPD (Lei 13.709/2018), especialmente em:
    • Base legal para rastreamento em tempo real, telemetria e geolocalização de motoristas.
    • Proteção de dados de clientes finais (B2C) e corporativos (B2B).
    • Contratos com operadores de dados, DPA, cláusulas de confidencialidade e retenção.
  • Apoiar resposta a incidentes de privacidade e demandas de titulares.

4) Contencioso, Pré-Contencioso e Recuperação de Crédito

  • Atuar (diretamente ou com escritórios externos) no contencioso cível, consumidor e trabalhista (estratégia, peças, audiências e acordos), priorizando soluções eficientes e redução de passivos.
  • Gerenciar carteira de processos (prazos, provisionamento, relatórios executivos) e padronizar defesas.
  • Atuar em sinistros de carga (avaria, roubo, extravio), abertura/gestão de sinistros com seguradoras e ações regressivas.
  • Coordenar cobrança e recuperação de crédito; estruturar acordos e garantias.

5) Tributário conectado ao Transporte (interface)

  • Interface com Fiscal/Tributário sobre ICMS no transporte, benefícios e obrigações acessórias correlatas a CT-e/MDF-e (sem substituir o especialista tributário).
  • Mitigar riscos de autuações vinculadas a operações logísticas e documentação fiscal de transporte.

6) Gestão de Terceiros e Due Diligence

  • Realizar due diligence jurídica de parceiros (transportadoras, armazéns, tecnologia), verificando regularidade, licenças, seguros (RCTR-C, RCF-DC) e compliance.
  • Manter cadastro jurídico atualizado e clausulados padrões para onboarding de parceiros.

7) Suporte a Expansão e Imobiliário/Facilities

  • Analisar contratos de locação/cessão de espaços logísticos, condomínio, utilities e obras de adequação.
  • Apoiar a expansão para novas praças, centros de distribuição e bases operacionais.

title: Especialista de Segurança Cibernética
description:
Resumo

Cria, revisa e implementa políticas, normas e procedimentos de segurança da informação para garantir a proteção dos dados e o cumprimento de normas e regulamentos. Desenvolve diretrizes de segurança para o uso seguro de redes, sistemas e aplicações. Realiza análise de riscos de segurança, identificando ameaças, vulnerabilidades e impactos potenciais para a organização. Propõe e implementa controles de segurança que mitigam os riscos identificados. Realiza avaliações regulares de risco em novos sistemas, aplicativos e atualizações de software. Monitora constantemente os sistemas de TI para identificar atividades suspeitas ou não autorizadas. Implementa e monitora sistemas de detecção de intrusão (IDS) e sistemas de prevenção de intrusão (IPS). Lidera e coordena respostas a incidentes de segurança cibernética, como violações de dados, malware, ransomware e outros tipos de ataques. Investiga incidentes, identifica a causa raiz e recomenda ações corretivas. Cria relatórios pós-incidente e desenvolve estratégias de prevenção para evitar futuras ocorrências. Conduz avaliações regulares de vulnerabilidade e testes de penetração (pentesting) para identificar fraquezas nos sistemas. Gerencia e prioriza a correção de vulnerabilidades por meio da aplicação de patches e atualizações de segurança. Gerencia e monitora sistemas de controle de acesso, assegurando que os usuários tenham apenas os privilégios necessários para realizar suas funções. Implementa e administra soluções de autenticação multifator (MFA) e sistemas de gerenciamento de identidades. Participa do desenvolvimento, manutenção e exercícios do Plano de Continuidade de Negócios e Plano de Recuperação de Desastres para garantir a continuidade das operações em caso de incidentes. Seleciona, especifica, configura e mantém ferramentas e tecnologias de segurança, como firewalls, antivírus, VPNs, sistemas de proteção de endpoints, DLP (Data Loss Prevention) e outros.

Requisitos

  • Experiência em Design de Arquitetura de Segurança;
  • Experiência em Monitoramento e Resposta a Incidentes;
  • Experiência em Teste de intrusão;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Segurança de Redes, Segurança de Aplicações e Segurança em Cloud;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Criptografia, Gestão de Identidade e Acesso (IAM).

Formação

Superior Completo em Sistemas de Informação, Gestão de Tecnologia da Informação, Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas afins.

  • Record a complete and accurate description in the appropriate document history.

  • 3

  • 1 Carry out emergency response role (See Station Bill).
  • 2 Demonstrate competence in emergency response drills and exercises.

Offshore – Demonstrate an understanding of PandAds Offshore – Handover Offshore – Diagnosis and fault finding Offshore – Reports Offshore – Computerised maintenance management system Offshore – Planning work Offshore – Dismantling, repair and reassemble equipment Offshore – Hazardous area classification Offshore – Safety management

Sobre nós

Somos a equipe de Tech Strategy & Advisory da Accenture. Somos referência global em como tecnologia e inovação reinventam negócios e promovem mais competitividade para qualquer empresa. A área de Tech Strategy combina conhecimento profundo de negócios e de domínios tecnológicos para ajudar nossos clientes a se tornarem mais competitivos, liberando valor e acelerando crescimento. Em um mundo marcado por transformações constantes, o C‑Suite precisa posicionar a tecnologia como diferencial estratégico, capaz de garantir agilidade e resiliência aos negócios. Novas arquiteturas de negócio e de tecnologia rompem com modelos tradicionais e criam a base necessária para competir e crescer nesse novo cenário.

O papel

Como Consultor(a) de Technology Strategy & Advisory, você atuará diretamente nas transformações que envolvem tecnologia em nossos clientes, ajudando a definir visões ousadas e roadmaps práticos. Você ajudará nossos clientes a identificar oportunidades de valor, a estruturar business cases sólidos, a pensar a modernização de suas áreas de Digital/IT/OT e a definir modelos operacionais que integrem negócios e tecnologia.

Responsabilidades principais

  • Identificar, priorizar e estruturar oportunidades de criação de valor, por meio de análises profundas do ambiente tecnológico atual.
  • Elaborar modelos operacionais de TI (IT Operating Models), governança de TI, business cases, roadmaps de transformação e planos de modernização.
  • Participar de iniciativas ligadas a fusões & aquisições e otimização de custos/eficiência operacional.
  • Fomentar inovação: desenvolver pontos de vista sobre o uso de tecnologias emergentes (por exemplo, AI, Agentes, Cloud, IoT, Cyber Security, Analytics) para suportar transformações em escala.
  • Apoiar na comunicação executiva: apresentar recomendações, conceitos complexos e resultados de forma clara, impactante e orientada por dados.
  • Ajudar a desenvolver times multidisciplinares, facilitando workshops, estruturando trabalhos analíticos, promovendo colaboração entre áreas.

Qualificações exigidas

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Administração, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas; idealmente com pós‑graduação ou MBA.
  • Pelo menos 2 a 4 anos de experiência em consultoria de estratégia ou função equivalente, com exposição a tecnologia + negócio.
  • Compreensão clara de conceitos relacionados a negócios e operação de modelos de TI, com roadmaps, business cases, modelagens financeiras e otimização operacional.
  • Habilidade analítica avançada, inclusive com uso de dados, visualização e storytelling executivo.
  • Forte comunicação, influência e relacionamento com stakeholders seniores.
  • Desejável conhecimento prático em tecnologias emergentes, incluindo fundamentos de Inteligência Artificial (Machine Learning, LLMs, GenAI) e uso de Agentes de AI para automação, tomada de decisão e orquestração de processos.

Diferenciais

description:
Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Main responsibilities

Promover, juntamente ao Gestor imediato, um ambiente que proporcione melhorias contínuas no processo assistencial, realizando interface com as demais áreas, a fim de garantir o cumprimento dos objetivos estipulados pela Instituição e o bom atendimento ao usuário.

description:
Conheça os principais desafios e responsabilidades da função

O PROPÓSITO DO GRUPO PROFARMA É ENTREGAR SAÚDE! No Grupo Profarma, a cultura é viva e inspira a forma como a gente trabalha e se relaciona todos os dias. Aqui, valorizamos quem é inconformado por natureza, faz acontecer, busca soluções criativas e está sempre em movimento para fazer melhor e encantar parceiros e clientes. Se você se com esse jeito de ser, confira a oportunidade abaixo e faça parte desse time!

Principal desafio e responsabilidade da função

Executar atividades relacionadas à área de manutenção e instalações prediais, realizando reparos, substituição de peças, inspeções, manutenção preventiva, testes, identificação de defeitos, montagem, reformas e consumo de materiais, visando o perfeito funcionamento das instalações.

  • Convênio com instituições de ensino

Sobre Nós

Fundado em 1961 com a criação da Profarma Distribuição, o Grupo Profarma consolidou-se como um dos líderes no mercado farmacêutico brasileiro, ocupando hoje uma relevante atuação no mercado nacional em distribuição.

Com 14 Centros de Distribuição e uma equipe de mais de 9.000 colaboradores, atuamos desde a negociação até a entrega de medicamentos e produtos de higiene e beleza para milhares de farmácias em todo o país.

Em 2013, ampliamos nossa atuação para o varejo farmacêutico por meio da Rede d1000, composta por mais de 270 lojas sob as bandeiras Drogasmil, Farmalife, Drogarias Tamoio e Drogaria Rosário.

Comprometidos com a promoção da saúde e do bem-estar, nossas equipes trabalham diariamente para oferecer experiências inclusivas, sustentáveis e socialmente engajadas. Seja de forma presencial ou por canais digitais, desenvolvemos soluções e serviços inovadores que nos posicionam como a melhor escolha para nossos parceiros. Afinal, entregar saúde é o nosso propósito.

Diversidade e Inclusão no Grupo Profarma

Acreditamos que enxergar é mais do que ver - é reconhecer as singularidades que tornam cada pessoa única. Por isso, reforçamos nosso compromisso com a Diversidade & Inclusão por meio do programa Diversidade em Cena.

Promovemos um ambiente acolhedor e respeitoso para todos, valorizando as diferenças de gênero, etnia, deficiências, orientação sexual (LGBTI+), crenças, religiões e outras individualidades.

Quer fazer parte dessa jornada com a gente? Junte-se ao Grupo Profarma!

OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to Global Manufacturing operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations. We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions, storage operations in Preá, and final-mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply-chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

  • Mid‑Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  • Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  • Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  • Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  • Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  • Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  • Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  • Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  • Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe)
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia's standards for quality, specifications, and finishes

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes)
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá‑Jericoacoara transfers

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards

Requirements

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred)
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus)
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable
  • Portuguese and English a must—any other language a plus

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports)
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs)

Benefits

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

title: Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027"), which for the first time is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator reports to the Training Site Infrastructure Manager and the FIFA Training Site Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Team Services, Team Facilities team and other stakeholders.

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ requires advanced infrastructure and technical services to deliver a seamless tournament experience. The Training Site Infrastructure Coordinator will work alongside the Training Site Infrastructure Manager on the successful delivery and readiness of all FWWC2023 training site infrastructure and overlay requirements throughout the country. The manager will also project manage all Host Country and Local Entity deliverables.

This role will also work with external stakeholders, such as Training Site Authorities, to be part of the Training Site infrastructure team in planning, delivering, and preparing all FWWC2027 training sites in Brazil. The successful candidate will work with the Training Site Authorities and local entity colleagues to ensure the delivery and readiness of the renovations, beautification, upgrade and completion of existing works at training sites. In addition, they will oversee infrastructure and overlay delivery, installation, and dismantling, as well as supply and storage of field of play and training equipment at training sites.

As a member of the Technical Services & Overlay team, you will also work closely with other workstreams, such as Pitch Management, Venue Design, and Dressing and Signage, to ensure the FWWC2027 is delivered to the highest possible standard and, where possible, leaves a lasting legacy.

The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA’s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction.

Key responsibilities

  • Assist the Training Site Infrastructure Manage in the design and delivery of infrastructure required at training sites for the FWWC2027.
  • Ensure specifications, space and area allocations are developed in compliance with the FIFA training site requirements and fit for purpose.
  • Monitoring the training site renovations, beautifications and upgrade program and overlay deliverables and timelines to ensure all training sites are ready for the participating Teams when they arrive.
  • Assist in the procurement, delivery and installation/storage of field of play and training equipment for all training sites.
  • Participating in regular review meetings to discuss the delivery and readiness of training sites with all external and internal stakeholders.
  • Assist in the handover and hand back of all training sites for the tournament period.
  • Working with Facility Management Services and Cleaning & Waste providers to ensure the training sites are maintained at the appropriate standards during the Teams’ time in the host country.
  • Ensure all equipment and overlay requested are provided and set up by the requirements and location.

Your profile

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 1 year experience in a coordination role in overlay, infrastructure, or technical services in events.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Strong and dynamic interpersonal, leadership and communication skills with an ability to maintain focus in a high-pressure and fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in supplier coordination.
  • Relationships with local suppliers and contractors and well-established networks within the industry would be advantageous.
  • Reliable and committed to meeting quality standards and deadlines, good planning and anticipation, focus on efficient implementation, and follow up after completion.
  • Knowledge of overlay delivery, temporary infrastructure, and technical services for major sporting events.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, BIM 360, MS Project, and other project management tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Excellent negotiation and contract management skills.
  • Driver’s license is a plus.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Digital Product Lead
description:
At Qima, we are on a mission to offer our clients smart solutions to make products you can trust. Operating in over 100 countries, we serve the consumer products, food, and life sciences industries and help more than 30,000 brands, retailers, manufacturers, and growers achieve quality excellence. We combine on-the- ground expertise with digital solutions that bring accuracy, transparency and intelligence for quality and compliance data. We are a leading provider of supply chain compliance solutions, partnering with brands, retailers, and importers to secure, manage, and optimize their global supply network.

Qima’s industry-leading experts for onsite inspections, supplier audits, and lab testing are supported by a digital platform that provides accuracy, transparency, and intelligence for quality and compliance data. Our culture is unique, with our 5,000 Qimates making decisions every day based on our Qima Values.

Job Description

Help us lead the strategy, design, and delivery of innovative digital solutions to enhance efficiency, client satisfaction, and compliance in the global food TIC (Testing, Inspection & Certification) industry. We are looking for an experienced Product Lead to combine business acumen, technology expertise, food quality knowledge, and emerging technologies to build scalable, data-driven products.

Key Missions

Define a clear product vision, roadmap, and success criteria aligned with business goals and standards (e.g., GlobalG.A.P., BRCGS). Collaborate across functions to prioritize high-value initiatives, leveraging AI and automation where relevant to improve outcomes.

Analysis & Solution Design

Drive requirements gathering and process mapping; create detailed functional specs, user stories, and workflows. Design robust, scalable solutions adhering to enterprise architecture, data governance, and best practices for usability and performance.

Project Delivery

Act as the main bridge between business, development, and QA teams. Manage agile projects from inception to release, ensuring accuracy, attention to detail, and effective resource planning.

Documentation & Governance

Develop and maintain comprehensive, accessible product documentation.

Testing & Implementation

Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and validation, incorporating rapid feedback loops. Support smooth rollouts, with a focus on adoption, data integrity, and long-term product stability.

Field Engagement (GOOB)

Engage directly with food audit operations: shadow audits, observe workflows, and capture user insights to ensure continuous improvement and strong local/global adoption.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related.

Experience: 6+ years in digital product management; strong track record in delivering large-scale solutions; food TIC sector experience preferred.

Technical Skills: Agile (Scrum/Kanban), requirements elicitation, Figma/Miro, SQL, API design/integration, AI-powered data analysis.

Languages: Fluent English & Portuguese ; Spanish beneficial.

Soft Skills: Strategic thinker, exceptional attention to detail, analytical rigor, proactive problem-solving, AI literacy, stakeholder engagement, leadership, adaptability, and high standards of quality.

Preferred: PMI-PBA, CSPO or equivalent certifications; experience with GlobalG.A.P., BRCGS.

You Will Gain: Opportunity to lead digital transformation in food quality and compliance; collaborate with global experts; experience real-world audits; grow within an innovative, mission-driven, international organization.

title: Marketing Manager BRA (Remote)
description:
Marketing Manager

A Marketing Manager is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing strategies that promote a company’s products or services, strengthen brand awareness, and drive sustainable growth. This role requires strategic oversight of marketing initiatives across both digital and traditional channels, ensuring alignment with the company’s objectives and target audience needs.

Key responsibilities include managing integrated marketing campaigns , from concept to execution, leveraging channels such as social media, email marketing, paid advertising, search engine optimization (SEO), content marketing, events, and print media. A Marketing Manager must analyze market trends, consumer behavior, and competitive landscapes to identify opportunities for innovation and differentiation.

The role also involves overseeing the creation of compelling content and brand messaging , ensuring consistency in tone, style, and visual identity across all platforms. Collaboration is crucial—Marketing Managers often work closely with sales, product development, and creative teams to ensure that marketing efforts support lead generation, customer engagement, and revenue goals.

Performance tracking is another critical aspect. Marketing Managers monitor key metrics such as conversion rates, ROI, customer acquisition cost, and engagement rates , using data insights to refine strategies and improve effectiveness. They also manage budgets, allocate resources efficiently, and negotiate with vendors or media partners to maximize returns on investment.

To succeed in this role, a Marketing Manager must possess strong leadership and team management skills , the ability to think both creatively and analytically, and a deep understanding of modern marketing tools and technologies. Adaptability, problem-solving, and excellent communication are essential to navigate fast-changing market dynamics and deliver impactful results.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.


THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Broadcast FIFA27 and Senior Partnerships Services Manager in Zurich HQ, the Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager FIFA27 will assume crucial responsibility in overseeing and facilitating the provision of services to FIFA’s Media Partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and coordinate the preparation of all aspects of services provided to FIFA’s Media Partners in the Host Country, excluding host broadcast production. This encompassing role includes accommodation, accreditation, catering, customs, filming permits, frequency licensing, logistics, transportation, venue access control, visas, work permits, site visits, and more.
  • Contribute hiring and supervising the Media Partnerships Services Manager. Coordinate an event team consisting of 4-6 skilled staff members based at different stadiums.
  • Maintain effective communication and work closely with the Zurich-based Relations and Services department.
  • Forge collaborative partnership with the Host Broadcast Production colleagues to determine and implement optimal unilateral services across all broadcast venues (Stadiums, International Broadcast Coordination Center, FIFA Fan Fests, and beyond).
  • Cultivate enduring relationships with key functional areas of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, fostering synergies and ensuring smooth operation of essential services.
  • Work hand in hand with the Relations management team to address the specific needs of Media Partners during their visits to the Host Cities, providing comprehensive support throughout the preparation phase.
  • Support organising various workshops as well as venue tours.
  • Manage and coordinate services for numerous operations and milestone events leading up to the tournament, starting with the Draw in December 2026.
  • Contribute actively to the seamless delivery of services during the tournament, always ensuring the highest standards of excellence.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Master’s degree or similar higher education in Business and/or Sports Management or equivalent education.

Experience

  • 5-7 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports industry is an advantage.
  • Experience in Broadcast environment is an advantage.
  • Experience of working in Brazil and knowledge of local culture will be an added benefit.
  • Experience in major sports events, such as the FIFA World Cup ™ or other FIFA events will be an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • ACCOUNTABILITY: We are looking for accountable individuals—people who take ownership of their responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and drive results with integrity. Individuals must be ready to step up, be reliable, and make a meaningful impact.
  • LEADERSHIP: We are seeking individuals with leadership qualities—those who inspire others, lead by example, and guide internal/external teams with confidence, empathy, and purpose to achieve set objectives under tight timelines.
  • INITIATIVE: We are seeking people with strong initiative—self-starters who take proactive steps, anticipate challenges, and go beyond what’s expected without waiting to be asked – who have the capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
  • DECISION MAKING: We are seeking decisive individuals, with the ability to identify critical situations and swiftly make decisions, who take initiative and calculated risks, who explore alternative solutions, and react promptly to unforeseen circumstances.
  • INNOVATION: We are looking for innovative thinkers—individuals who challenge the status quo, bring fresh ideas, and find creative solutions to complex problems.
  • VISION: We are looking for visionary individuals—people who see the bigger picture, formulate strategic plans, think long-term, perceive the organization’s global environmental impact and help shape bold ideas into reality.
  • INCLUSIVITY: We seek individuals who love teamwork, actively listen, embrace diverse perspectives, and help build collaborative, respectful teams.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Fluent in English and (Brazilian) Portuguese. Any other language is a plus.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) and online collaboration tools.
  • This position requires frequent travel to participate in meetings and venue tours.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Supervisor de Manutenção
description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua nos segmentos automotivo e do agronegócio, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania, a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) e Supermac(AM e RR).

No segmento do agronegócio, por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP), a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkotruck, uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

title: Tax Sr. Associate
description:
Descrição da Vaga

Tax Sr. Associate Credit Saison Brazil • Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

About the Company

Credit Saison Brazil (“CSBR”) is part of Credit Saison Group, which has Credit Saison Co. Ltd. (Japan) as ultimate parent and Saison International (Singapore) as its international headquarter. Our core businesses are lending operation and equity investment consisting of early‑stage start‑up investment and M&A / joint venture.

Founded in 1951, Credit Saison Co. Ltd., is one of Japan’s largest non‑bank financial corporations listed on Tokyo Stock Exchange. Outside Japan, over 1,000 talented employees are working across global markets because of Credit Saison's dedication to foster an environment of diversity, collaboration, inclusion and career growth. The group has a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, delivering resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact.

Established in 2023, CSBR primarily provides credit solutions in Brazilian private debt market to support the innovators as a transformative partner in contributing to financial inclusion. So, if you’re passionate about making positive impacts in the finance sector while working in a multi‑cultural environment, we want to hear from you. Join us on this exciting journey, where your talent can make a meaningful difference and together, let’s contribute to the future of finance in Brazil.

About the Role

Tax Calculation & Compliance : Expertise in the calculation and review of all major federal taxes : IRPJ / CSLL (Annual / Quarterly Actual Profit Lucro Real and Presumed Profit Lucro Presumido), and PIS / COFINS (Cumulative and Non‑Cumulative regimes).

Deep knowledge of federal withholding taxes (IRRF, CSRF, INSSRF) and their accounting reconciliation.

Experience with tax benefits and fiscal incentives + Tax Credits.

Auxiliary Obligations — Extensive experience in the preparation, review, and timely submission of federal and state Tax obligations, including : DCTF, ECF, EFD Contributions, EFD Reinf, ECD, Per / Dcomp, GIA, SPED Fiscal, E-financeira, Dimp.

Tax Credits & Recovery : Proven track record in identifying and processing tax credits, including claims for undue or overpayment, IRPJ / CSLL negative balances, and PIS / COFINS credits (Restitution and Reimbursement requests).

Audit & Litigation Support — Experience managing the Tax Audit calendar and serving as the primary point of contact for external audits.

Ability to analyze and respond to official notices, subpoenas (intimações), decision‑making orders (despachos decisórios), and internal preliminary tax reviews from the Brazilian Federal Revenue (Receita Federal do Brasil).

Tax Planning & Strategy : Knowledge of Transfer Pricing (specifically for Services) and the ability to act as a Tax Business Partner to internal controls (risk management) and international finance teams (supporting international expansion, and local registration).

Financial Reconciliation — Advanced skill in performing detailed fiscal cross‑checks (ECF x EFD Contribuições x DCTF x Apurações x DARFs) and reconciling tax‑related general ledger accounts (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, IRRF, PCC).

Collaboration & Communication — Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative attitude, focused on sharing knowledge, working effectively in a team environment, and ensuring effective internal customer service.

Requirements

  • Over 10 years of progressive experience in the fiscal and tax field, with expertise gained across diverse sectors including Technology / Services and Finance.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or Law and specialization / Post‑Graduate certification in Taxation.
  • Advanced proficiency and practical expertise in leading ERP systems.
  • Native or bilingual proficiency in Portuguese & English (both verbal and written).
  • Able to commute to the office in São Paulo a few times a week.
  • Knowledge in Brazilian Tax regulation.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel .
  • Well‑rounded understanding and mindset in corporate governance pertaining to Brazilian central Bank.

Preferred Competencies

  • Process Automation & Design : Experience in the automation of tax and P2P processes (invoice receipt, payment, tax calculation, and ancillary obligations) and in the mapping / design of corporate tax processes and policies.
  • Project Management & Coordination : Demonstrated ability to manage complex tax projects, coordinate team activities, and monitor performance using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

title: Accreditation Operations Senior Manager
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. The tournament requires a highly coordinated, secure, and reliable accreditation operation across all venues and official facilities. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Accreditation Operations Senior Manager plays a senior operational leadership role within the FIFA27 Accreditation team, overseeing the coordination and delivery of accreditation operations across the tournament footprint. He/She will be responsible for the end-to-end planning, coordination, and delivery of accreditation operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, ensuring consistent, compliant, and high-quality service delivery across all tournament venues and official facilities.

Reporting to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager, and working in close collaboration with FIFA Zürich Accreditation, Technology, Security, Client Groups, and Venue Operations, the role provides operational leadership, governance, and oversight of accreditation centre operations, badge production and distribution, accreditation venue teams, and service delivery standards.

The role provides oversight and guidance to Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators and acts as a senior operational escalation point.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Planning & Management

  • Manage the overall accreditation operations strategy across all tournament venues and facilities
  • Define and implement accreditation operational policies, procedures, workflows and service standards in alignment with FIFA requirements
  • Establish and maintain operational timelines, resourcing plans, and risk mitigation measures.
  • Contribute to tournament readiness activities, including operational testing and scenario planning.

Venue & Facilities Management

  • Plan and oversee the delivery of fully equipped Accreditation Centres, including overlay, FF&E, technology, power, lighting, and connectivity.
  • Supervise the setup, operation, and dismantling of accreditation centres and badge distribution points.
  • Ensure venue teams are trained, resourced, and aligned with central accreditation policies and procedures.
  • Coordinate the Accreditation volunteers planning, including shift structures and service levels.
  • Supervise day‑day accreditation centre operations across all venues and facilities.

Badge Production & Distribution Oversight

  • Define requirements and manage procurement of accreditation consumables in line with FIFA27 Inc. standards and timelines.
  • Oversee badge production, quality control, secure storage, logistics, and distribution.
  • Implement robust stock controls, audit processes, and reporting mechanisms across all accreditation facilities.

Team Leadership & Support

  • Lead and manage a team of Accreditation Operations Managers and Coordinators.
  • Support and guide venue-based accreditation managers, temporary staff and volunteers.
  • Provide training, coaching, and performance oversight to ensure consistent service delivery and operational excellence.

Issue Resolution & Stakeholder Support

  • Act as the final escalation point for complex operational issues related to badge issuance, access rights, or client service.
  • Work closely with the Accreditation Systems, Client Group Managers and Coordinators, Security and Technology teams to resolve operational challenges efficiently.

Compliance, Security & Governance

  • Ensure all accreditation operations comply with FIFA access control policies, data protection requirements, and security protocols.
  • Support venue zoning implementation and access rights validation.
  • Ensure accurate documentation, secure handling of materials, and operational compliance at all times.

Monitoring & Reporting

  • Track operational performance and provide regular operational updates to the FIFA27 Accreditation Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post‑event reporting, lessons learned, and operational debriefs.

YOUR PROFILE

Education & Experience

  • University degree or equivalent higher education in Event Management, Operations, or related field.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in accreditation and/or major event operations.
  • Proven experience managing venue operations and large‑scale logistics in complex event environments.
  • Familiarity with accreditation systems and access control processes.
  • Experience working in multi‑lingual, high‑pressure environments.
  • Experience with FIFA or major international sporting events or with accreditation Systems is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong operational leadership and coordination skills.
  • Excellent organisational and logistical planning skills.
  • High attention to detail and operational discipline.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross‑functional coordination skills.
  • Ability to operate calmly and decisively in time‑critical situations.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, Project) and planning tools.
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Knowledge of 3D modelling or planning tools is a plus.

Additional Requirements

  • Eligibility to work in Brazil.
  • Willingness to relocate to Rio de Janeiro for the duration of the contract.
  • Flexibility to work extended hours during critical operational phases.

title: Care Coordinator
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff \"for fit\" makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.


Here Is What We Offer



  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support

  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements

  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match

  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths

  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture


Join Howard University and thrive with us!


Benefits page:


Basic Functions


To provide coordination of client-centered services that link clients with substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health with coordinated care and psychosocial services. Working closely and collaboratively with the HUH inpatient and Consultation‑Liaison and Addiction Medicine Consult services and the ambulatory Mental Health Clinic (Behavioral Health Clinic) teams, the Care Coordinator assesses clients’ needs and support systems; facilitates timely, coordinated access to and continuation of medically appropriate substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health care health and support services; assists in expediting appropriate discharge from inpatient facilities, as medically appropriate, and assists in preventing unnecessary hospitalizations; and establishes and maintains relations with case managers, healthcare providers, social services and other agency representatives to bridge the gaps between health, social service, entitlements and other systems.


Principal Accountabilities



  • Assists in development and implements protocols for coordinating the substance use disorder, behavioral health, and general health services for individual clients or patients with substance use or co‑occurring psychiatric and substance use disorders.

  • Provides care coordination services to a caseload of patients/clients, as assigned by the PI, Project Director, or Care Manager Coordinator.

  • Operates as a liaison between the Departments of Psychiatry and Community and Family Medicine.

  • Social Work and the DC Department of Health and other community groups.

  • Ensures that patients receive necessary follow‑up substance use or psychiatric disorder treatment and medical treatments.

  • May accompany patients to the initial or follow‑up visits and may help arrange transportation and scheduling of appointments.

  • Conducts intake and follow up assessments of clients’/patients’ behavioral health and medical/functional status; structural vulnerabilities; psychological; educational; financial; and individual support needs.

  • Reviews all initial client bio‑psychosocial assessments and reassessments.

  • Attends department trainings and meetings relevant in ongoing effort to increase knowledge and skills to work effectively with clients.

  • Attends annual and mandatory compliance Program training, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPPA) Privacy training, maintains adherence to the Health Sciences Compliance Program, the Howard University Code of Ethics and the Health Sciences Standards of Conduct.

  • Works on behalf of patients receiving medications for opioid use disorder treatment to improve the system of care by identifying service gaps and identifying services that are needed and ensuring that these services are provided in a courteous and dignified manner.

  • Maintains confidentiality of patients, their families and the staff.

  • Performs other related duties as assigned.


Core Competencies



  • Knowledge of the care needed for individuals receiving MOUD or other substance use disorder treatment.

  • Knowledge of community resources to establish referral systems with community agencies to facilitate coordinated management plans for patients and their families.

  • Ability to express ideas clearly using appropriate language in communicating with a wide range of health, socioeconomic, and cultural groups.

  • Competence in both oral and written English.

  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with clients and their family members and other treatment or service providers; physicians, staff, University and Hospital personnel, and the general public.

  • Proficiency in both oral and written English.


Minimum Requirements


A Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field, or 2 or more years of experience in the field.


Compliance Salary Range Disclosure


$46,700- $52,700

Company Introduction:

Apex is a growing agency focused on Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), aimed at boosting client sales without increasing ad budgets. We work with top e-commerce brands to enhance their websites, using data and proven strategies to drive growth.

With a solid record of delivering results, we combine technical skills with a focus on improving user experience. As we expand, we offer opportunities to work with a talented team, solving challenges and applying advanced CRO methods.

If you’re looking to make a difference and help e-commerce businesses grow, alongside a team of driven professionals, consider joining the Apex team.

About the Role

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is responsible for enhancing the performance of our clients’ websites by implementing data-driven strategies that maximize their conversion rates.

This position plays a key role in analyzing user behavior, identifying optimization opportunities, and implementing changes to improve overall site performance. You will collaborate closely with copywriters, designers, web developers, and other team members.

Your responsibilities will include developing Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) strategies for our clients, auditing their websites to identify optimization opportunities, running A/B and multivariate tests to determine the changes needed, and working with our internal teams to execute, monitor, and further improve the results of the optimizations implemented.

Mission Statement:

The primary mission of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert is to drive measurable improvements in our clients’ e-commerce website performance by implementing tailored CRO strategies. This will involve working directly on optimizing brand websites and using data-driven insights to enhance user experiences, maximize conversion rates, and deliver real business growth to our clients.

General responsibilities:

The responsibilities of our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert include, but are not limited to:

  • Developing and implementing tailored, data-driven backend CRO strategies for our agency’s clients to enhance their website performance and maximize conversion rates
  • Performing thorough brand audits of clients’ websites to identify areas for improvement
  • Conducting in-depth analysis of user behavior using analytical CRO tools, user feedback, heatmaps, and session recordings to identify trends and opportunities for optimization
  • Designing, executing, and managing A/B and multivariate tests to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of the CRO changes implemented

  • Staying up-to-date with the latest trends and tools in the CRO, e-commerce, and digital marketing industries to continuously refine your own strategies and practices
  • Maintaining thorough documentation of all CRO projects, including test results and client interactions, to track progress and outcomes
  • Assisting in the development of CRO case studies and success stories for marketing purposes

Overall, the Conversion Rate Optimization Expert will play an important role in driving measurable growth for our clients by leveraging data-driven insights to optimize their online presence, enhance user experiences, and ultimately increase conversion rates across their e-commerce platforms.

The Conversion Rate Optimization Expert position includes committing to the following:

As our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert, you need to bring a highly proactive and analytical approach to your work. You should be able to work independently with high levels of reliability, transparency, and trust. You also need the ability to work under pressure and manage multiple clients’ CRO strategies with great attention to detail and the required technical abilities. The ideal person for this role is a rational thinker who enjoys problem-solving, who can work fast and efficiently, and who has excellent communication skills. In addition, good organizational, time management, and analytical skills will help you succeed in this position and work well within our team environment.

Availability and consistency are highly important factors for us, so our Conversion Rate Optimization Expert should display these qualities regarding workload commitments and availability during office hours.
