Responsiveness and autonomy will be essential traits for this role.

Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. Overview

Do you have a strong background in quality assurance, a structured approach to testing, and want to join one of the largest technology companies in the Nordics? Then this is the role for you.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting . Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving clients’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By combining engineering excellence with disciplined quality practices, we support customers developing and operating critical digital platforms.

In this role, you will work in close collaboration with product, engineering, and design teams, ensuring high quality, reliability, and scalability of backend services in a modern cloud-based environment.

When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Quality Assurance Engineer, you will

  • Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to refine user stories, ensuring acceptance criteria are clear, complete, and testable.
  • Conduct daily evaluations of the QA swimlane in JIRA for new feature work and collaborate with engineers to execute test cycles.
  • Design, develop, and document comprehensive test plans and test cases for new and existing backend services.
  • Develop and maintain Postman API tests and automated integration test suites targeting backend services and data flows across AWS components (SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, EventBridge).
  • Implement and manage API contract testing to validate integrations and ensure data consistency across internal and external services.
  • Design, execute, and maintain performance, load, and stress tests for critical backend infrastructure to ensure scalability and reliability.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to define and test security, access control, and compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) for backend services handling sensitive data.
  • Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to establish continuous quality gates and support safe, frequent deployments.
  • Manage initial release completion, acting as the first quality gate by approving tickets when testing passes or returning them for rework when defects are identified.
  • Collaborate with QA Engineers across squads to ensure a consistent and high-quality experience for both patient- and provider-facing features.

Who we are looking for

  • Experienced QA professional with 5+ years of experience in startup or fast-paced environments, combining strong manual testing skills with automated testing capabilities.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience testing AWS-based backend architectures using Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of testing patterns for distributed systems and AWS services such as SQS, SNS, DynamoDB, and EventBridge .
  • Proficiency in a modern programming language such as Python, Java, or TypeScript for writing and maintaining automated test suites.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing automated integration, end-to-end, and component tests .
  • Experience with performance, load, and stress testing applied to backend infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with API contract testing frameworks .
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD principles and experience integrating automated tests into deployment pipelines.
  • Familiarity with agile development practices and bug tracking tools (e.g. JIRA, BrowserStack ).
  • Strong analytical mindset with a continuous improvement approach.
  • Detail-oriented in test execution and thorough in documentation.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional teams.

Experience in the healthcare domain is considered an advantage.

As a person, you are a team player who takes responsibility for quality, works in a structured and disciplined manner, and communicates clearly. You value accuracy, reliability, and continuous improvement in everything you do.

We offer

We offer professional growth, meaningful projects, an open culture, and a strong work-life balance. You will have the opportunity to work in a growing and future-oriented sector, contributing to high-impact digital solutions. We provide a hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working, and we believe in curiosity and continuous learning as technology evolves.

Location: Asunción, Paraguay (Hybrid)

We perform background checks on all final candidates. Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.

Additional Information

At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.

title: Técnico de Manutenção - Volta Redonda / RJ
description:
Técnico de Manutenção - Volta Redonda / RJ

Manter os equipamentos em perfeito estado de funcionamento, realizar manutenção técnica, limpeza geral, acompanhar terceiros na solução de problemas quando estes fogem de nossa alçada, realizar testes e vistorias frequentes nos dispositivos de segurança, conservar o aspecto visual, iluminação do ponto, implantar melhorias visando a satisfação do cliente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar atendimentos operacionais dos PCs: repor suprimentos, papel e filtro de ar, substituir consumíveis e trocar peças, baixar aplicativos, realizar vistorias dos PCs, verificar se estão em perfeitas condições, acompanhar fornecedores para reparos técnicos, configurar softwares e manter atualizada a comunicação visual do ponto.
  • Reparar e trocar componentes que apresentem defeito no equipamento, identificado por meio de conhecimento técnico. Solicitar peças para a Logística através das ferramentas do sistema ETA e transportadoras.
  • Liberar o ponto para que o responsável pela manutenção (pode ser da concessionária de telecomunicações, empreiteiro, empresa que faz manutenção) possa executar o reparo no defeito.
  • Estar atento aos dispositivos de segurança dos equipamentos, observando se não há tentativas de fraude. Utilizar conhecimentos técnicos sobre o funcionamento do sistema e testes para manutenções quando necessário.
  • Garantir boa sinalização e iluminação dos pontos, aspectos visuais como pintura, adesivos e limpeza, utilizando materiais de limpeza e peças de reposição, além de acionar empreiteiras quando necessário para atividades além do escopo.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Escolaridade: Técnico ou superior completo em elétrica, eletrônica, mecatrônica, mecânica, informática ou afins;
  • Conhecimentos de microinformática (hardware e software);
  • Imprescindível saber dirigir e possuir CNH B definitiva;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar finais de semana e feriados (escala 5x2).

title: Implementations Specialist Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description:
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. As an implementations specialist, you will become an equity expert and use that knowledge to implement our clients onto the Carta software, setting them up for long‑term success. You will work to:

  • Establish strong customer relationships and inspire long‑term loyalty by providing a high quality and timely on‑boarding process as the first service provider post‑sale
  • Migrate and maintain the quality of clients data to Carta’s Onboarding Spreadsheet in Excel
  • Coordinate and manage inputs needed from both the clients and their law firms
  • Train clients on how to use Carta Software: you feel comfortable working with data, business systems, and developing training content for our customers
  • Continuously look for ways to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the on‑boarding process
  • Work closely with product, engineering and our internal implementations leaders to improve the experience for our customers

The Team You’ll Work With

Carta is looking for an Implementation Specialist to join our Rio SMB/MM Team as part of our larger Delivery team. Our Delivery team members have grown to become some of the strongest contributors in our company due to their thorough understanding of our software, customers, and the business value we deliver. Ideal candidates will have a strong passion for financial services, building customer relationships, project delivery, and analytical problem solving.

About You:

  • You’re proficient in Excel and have experience with CRMs (preferably Salesforce)
  • You’re eager to learn or have experience working with: Mixmax, Talkdesk, and Guru
  • You have strong project management and organization skills – must be able to manage multiple on‑boardings (40+) at a time
  • You are familiar with or will become familiar with Private Equity and Capitalization
  • You have great people skills and a high degree of empathy
  • You have the ability to work cross‑functionally with teams
  • You embrace change and constantly seek ways to better your process and your team
  • You possess a helpful and professional attitude and can exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues
  • Knowledge of finance and accounting is a plus
  • Experience working at a high‑growth software company is a plus

Disclosures:

  • We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a positive interview experience for every candidate. If accommodations due to a disability or medical condition are needed, please connect with the talent partner via email.
  • We will only contact you from an @carta.com or @carta-external.com domain. Report any contact from unapproved domains to

Especialista de Dados e Remuneração – Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Join to apply for the Especialista de Dados e Remuneração – Rio de Janeiro/RJ role at Infotec Brasil

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Desenvolver, implementar e revisar políticas e práticas de remuneração fixa e variável (curto e longo prazo);
  • Conduzir análises salariais internas e de mercado, utilizando benchmarks e pesquisas salariais (como Mercer, Korn Ferry, Aon, entre outras);
  • Realizar avaliação e classificação de cargos com base em metodologias como Hay, Mercer, entre outras;
  • Apoiar nos processos de movimentações salariais, promoções e ajustes de mérito, com base em critérios analíticos e estratégicos;
  • Desenvolver dashboards, relatórios e análises preditivas sobre remuneração, turnover, entre outros indicadores;
  • Traduzir dados em insights acionáveis para apoiar a liderança e a área de RH;
  • Automatizar processos de coleta e análise de dados, garantindo a integridade e qualidade da informação;
  • Liderar ou participar de projetos de transformação na área de remuneração e gestão de pessoas;
  • Apoiar processos de planejamento orçamentário relacionados a headcount e custos de pessoal;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva junto a Business Partners e lideranças, apoiando decisões com base em dados.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação Nível Superior em Administração, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharias ou afins;
  • Sólida experiência em metodologias de remuneração e estruturação de cargos;
  • Domínio de Excel avançado e ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de HRIS (como SAP SuccessFactors, ADP, Workday, etc.);
  • Conhecimento de estatística aplicada a dados de RH é um diferencial.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  • Inscrição
  • Testes
  • Entrevista Técnica
  • Proposta de Trabalho
  • Contratação

Bem-vindo(a) ao mundo Infotec!

Somos a Infotec Brasil, uma empresa referência nacional em terceirização de serviços, processos (BPO) e pessoas. Em 2025, celebramos 40 anos de trajetória, atuando com excelência nos setores de Óleo e Gás, Energia, Mineração e Siderurgia.

Nosso propósito é permitir que nossos clientes mantenham o foco em suas estratégias principais, enquanto nós cuidamos das eficiências operacionais. Para isso, buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer a diferença, crescer e inovar conosco.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por desafios, aprendizado constante e quer fazer parte de uma cultura dinâmica, colaborativa e transformadora, venha viver a #CulturaAzuleLaranja .

Na Infotec, o colaborador é protagonista da própria jornada. Oferecemos um ecossistema completo de apoio, desenvolvimento e reconhecimento, com destaque para:

  • Central de Atendimento ao Colaborador (CAC); suporte humanizado desde o onboarding até o dia a dia;
  • Academia Infotec: trilhas de capacitação técnica e comportamental, promovendo aprendizagem contínua;
  • My Redcognition: nossa plataforma de gamificação que reconhece e valoriza conquistas individuais e coletivas, além de ser um canal ativo de comunicação interna;
  • Ambiente colaborativo, ágil e orientado a resultados;
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento com base em meritocracia;
  • Política ativa de diversidade e inclusão, respeitando e valorizando diferentes histórias, origens e perspectivas;
  • Projetos com grandes empresas do cenário nacional e foco em excelência operacional.

Salário: 100% comissionado e regime autônomo

Benefícios:

  • Desconto para realizar o curso de TTI.
  • Suporte para dar entrada no CRECI.
  • Treinamentos constantes sobre vendas e mercado imobiliário.
  • Incentivo para atingimento de metas.
  • Desenvolvimento de Carreira.
  • Treinamento profissionalizante para corretor novato.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. title: Technical Services Senior Manager
description:
Technical Services Senior Manager

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Technical Services Senior Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, coordination, and delivery of all technical services across tournament venues, ensuring full alignment with FIFA requirements and international standards. The role leads the integration and operational readiness of venue infrastructure services including power systems (grid, overlay, and backup), containment, water and waste, HVAC, and broadcast technical support across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.

The position oversees the planning, execution, and supervision of technical services and infrastructure operations, managing power contractors and key suppliers, coordinating containment planning, and leading stadium technical inspections and independent audits. Working closely with internal teams, Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, service providers, and other stakeholders, the role ensures technical compliance, cross-functional alignment, and delivery excellence while maintaining timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate closely with key Functional Areas to define, refine, and validate technical services requirements, including power, containment, water and waste, HVAC, and floodlighting, across stadiums, training sites, and non-competition venues.
  • Lead coordination with Host Cities, Stadium Authorities, power contractors, utility providers, and suppliers to ensure seamless planning, integration, and delivery of power solutions.
  • Support and contribute to procurement activities, including preparation of technical inputs for RFPs, participation in tendering processes, technical evaluations, and coordination with contracted suppliers and delivery partners.
  • Oversee the development, implementation, and performance of power infrastructure, including grid, overlay, and backup systems, ensuring alignment with FIFA standards and operational requirements.
  • Manage containment planning and execution, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient routing for power, broadcast, and other technical services.
  • Monitor progress, quality, and compliance of technical services works, proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and mitigation measures.
  • Coordinate stadium technical inspections, readiness reviews, and independent technical audits, ensuring timely closure of findings and follow-up actions.
  • Ensure full compliance with FIFA technical guidelines and international standards, while balancing operational needs, timelines, budgets, and quality benchmarks.
  • Act as the central technical interface between Functional Areas, suppliers, and external stakeholders, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and decision-making.
  • Support procurement, contracting, and supplier performance management related to power, MEP and technical services, including scope definition and technical evaluation.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by capturing lessons learned and driving standardization and best practices across venues.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical or engineering field
  • A minimum of 8 years work experience in a technical services related field within Major Events/Sports Organization
  • Experience with Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling)
  • Strong technical knowledge in Energy / MEP required (e.g. Temporary Power, Ventilation and Cooling, Cabling, Entertainment)
  • Proficient in MS Office and planning software and online collaboration tools
  • Excellent organizational, coordination, and communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.
  • Availability to travel as needed

description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Complexity: Rendering massive tables and managing strict validation logic for mission-critical data pipelines.
  • Interactivity: Building conversational UIs (streaming chat) and high-performance time-series dashboards that update in real-time.
  • Visualization: Designing intuitive interfaces for Data Lineage, Knowledge Graphs, and Entity Mapping.

You’ll Do

You will join a high-performance team, ensuring design consistency across the platform while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • Component Architecture: Create a reusable, strictly typed Angular component library that scales across AI, Dashboard, and Admin modules.
  • Performance: Optimize change detection strategies and virtual scrolling to ensure the UI remains responsive and performant, whether rendering a live data stream or a 3D object.
  • Data-Driven Design: Handle complex JSON schemas and heavy payloads, ensuring data precision from API to UI

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Data Platform & Management Tools

  • Build Management Interfaces: Develop the "Control Room" for Data Engineers, including Data Catalog and Pipeline Configuration screens.
  • Heuristics & Mapping: Create efficient workflows for "Entity Matching" that allow users to visually map raw sensor tags to physical assets.
  • Visualizing Lineage: Implement DAG visualizations (D3.js or similar) to allow users to trace data asset layers and dependencies.

AI Interfaces & Visualization

  • Build AI Assistant UI: Develop rich conversational interfaces that support streaming responses (SSE), markdown rendering, and interactive "artifacts".
  • Advanced Dashboarding: Implement high-performance time-series charts using Plotly.js, ensuring smooth zooming/panning on large datasets.
  • Document Handling: Develop integrated viewers for PDF documents and rich media, allowing Agents to cite sources visually.

The Technology Stack

We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Framework: Angular 16+ (Expert level), TypeScript, RxJS.
  • State Management: NgRx or Signals.
  • Visualization: Plotly.js (Time-series), D3.js/DAGs (Lineage).
  • API Integration: REST APIs (FastAPI), Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets (using Socket.io)

Qualifications

  • Component Architect: You write clean, decoupled components and understand how to build a UI kit that scales.
  • UX Sensibility: You understand that a "Chat" interface needs to feel immediate and care about loading states and smooth transitions.
  • You take pride in building tools that make other engineers productive, caring deeply about workflow efficiency and keyboard shortcuts.

Must Haves

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 5+ years of experience in Frontend Development (Angular focus).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and reactive programming patterns.
  • Experience building Admin Dashboards, B2B SaaS interfaces, or complex SPAs.
  • Ability to handle complex API integrations and data modeling on the client side.
  • Advanced English communication skills

Good To Have

  • Visualization: Hands-on experience with Plotly.js, D3.js, or Lineage/DAG graphs.
  • AI/Chat: Experience building Chat/LLM interfaces and handling streaming text.
  • Data Heavy: Familiarity with high-performance libraries and virtual scrolling.
  • Media/Geo: Experience with PDF rendering in-browser or Map/GIS libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox).

This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

  • Monitorar o suprimento de materiais e equipamentos em estoque no contrato, sinalizar necessidade ou efetuar solicitações necessárias, realizar a conferência no ato do recebimento e organizar a alocação.
  • Receber e assinar os atestados dos colaboradores, encaminhando-os para o superior, para controle de faltas e tratativa adequada de abonos.
  • Monitorar assiduidade e pontualidade dos colaboradores através do acompanhamento da Folha e Cartão de ponto.
  • Higienizar o material e utensílios utilizados no plantão anterior, organizando e acondicionando em local específico para continuidade das atividades previstas.
  • Ler e registrar informações no livro de ocorrência, no início e ao final do plantão, visando adequada continuidade das atividades do contrato.
  • Fazer a passagem de plantão em conjunto com a liderança do outro plantão, fazendo a ronda nos setores, sinalizando as ocorrências, registrando as informações, visando adequada continuidade das atividades no contrato.

  • Executar atividades afins, de acordo com as suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.

title: Cleaning and Waste Cluster Coordinator FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (FWWC2027) hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Cleaning and Waste Management Coordinator will support the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager in the planning, operational readiness, implementation, and monitoring of cleaning and waste management operations across FIFA Official Sites. The role supports waste minimisation by reviewing and assessing procurement and service contracts and contributes to achieving defined waste diversion targets.

The position is execution-focused and site-oriented, responsible for supporting readiness planning, coordinating day-to-day operations, and monitoring service delivery during test events and tournament operations. The CLW Coordinator plays a key role in translating strategic and functional requirements into practical, on-the-ground execution, ensuring operational continuity, compliance with FIFA requirements, and the timely identification and resolution of issues at the venue level.

The ideal candidate will combine expertise in event operations, sustainable cleaning, and waste management with strong project management skills. This role will focus on optimizing operational efficiency, ensuring stakeholder satisfaction, and minimizing environmental impact while adhering to FIFA’s stringent standards.

Key responsibilities

Planning & Operational Readiness

  • Support the development and readiness planning of cleaning and waste management operational plans across stadiums and other FIFA Official Sites.
  • Contribute to Service Level Agreement (SLA) development and alignment with Functional Area (FA) leads, ensuring requirements are clearly defined, operationally feasible, and venue-ready.
  • Support Service Level Requirement (SLR) alignment with stadium facility management teams, ensuring consistency with existing venue operations, infrastructure, and constraints.
  • Participate in readiness assessments, site walk-throughs, and test events to validate operational plans, staffing levels, infrastructure, and service flows.

Operational Coordination & Delivery

  • Coordinate day-to-day cleaning and waste management operations in line with approved operational plans, service levels, and schedules.
  • Support match-day, non-match-day, and peak-load operations to ensure service continuity and operational effectiveness.
  • Monitor contractor performance on site and report deviations, risks, and non-compliance to the Senior Cleaning and Waste Management Manager.

Sustainable Waste Operations & Infrastructure

  • Support waste minimisation and waste diversion efforts through the correct implementation of waste streams and operational controls.
  • Assist in the deployment and operation of temporary waste management infrastructure, including interim collection points and resource recovery areas.
  • Monitor correct segregation and handling of waste streams and provide practical on-site guidance to teams and contractors.

Monitoring, Reporting & Issue Resolution

  • Conduct regular site inspections to assess operational readiness, cleanliness standards, and waste management performance.
  • Support data collection, basic reporting, and performance tracking against defined waste diversion targets.
  • Identify operational issues early and support escalation and resolution processes in coordination with the Senior Manager.
  • Contribute to post-event reviews, lessons learned, and continuous operational improvements.

Team & Contractor Coordination

  • Support on-site supervision and coordination of cleaning and waste management crews.
  • Assist with operational briefings, inductions, and coordination meetings.
  • Promote compliance with HSE requirements and safe working practices across all operations.

Your profile

  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in cleaning, waste management, facility operations, practical sustainability or event operations.
  • Experience of working at large-scale sporting events, major events, or complex multi-venue operations is strongly preferred.
  • Practical understanding of cleaning operations, sustainable upstream and downstream management of discarded materials, and contractor-based service delivery.
  • Experience coordinating service providers and working in live operational environments.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Environmental Management, Sustainability, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong operational coordination and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure event environments.
  • Clear communication skills and ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
  • Problem-solving mindset with a hands-on, solution-oriented approach.
  • Good reporting and documentation skills.
  • Working knowledge of HSE principles related to cleaning and waste operations.
  • Willingness to travel extensively between FIFA Official Sites
  • Flexibility to work irregular hours, including match days and peak operational periods
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

description:
The Software Alliances team at Canonical works with leading software companies to optimize and enable their products with Ubuntu and other Canonical software, for instance our AI offerings. Enterprises are able to receive the benefits of open source, securely maintained, and validated solutions from cloud to edge, whether purchased from Canonical, embedded in Alliance partners' products, or accessed through the cloud.

The successful candidate is someone who has a background in technology, engineering or product management and is interested in continuing to grow their career in business development. If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you. This role is ideal for early career professionals with up to 7 years of experience.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the Americas or EMEA region.

The role entails

  • Collaborating with product, engineering, alliance and marketing teams at partners to align on open-source strategies.
  • Capturing partner requirements, evaluating gaps, and identifying Canonical opportunities.
  • Coordinating with marketing and product teams on messaging, content creation, and launch plans.
  • Creating partner- and customer-facing materials like reference architectures, joint blueprints, webinars, presentations, videos, and white papers.
  • Driving Ubuntu adoption within targeted alliance accounts, advocating its benefits to stakeholders and working with partners on enablement training for their development, delivery, support and commercial teams.
  • Influencing alliance partners to build with Canonical technology.
  • Up to 25% travel, including internationally, for internal conferences and to drive partnerships in person.

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.
  • Bachelor's degree in science, technology and/or engineering.
  • Experience in software development and system architecture.
  • Customer-facing experience in software engineering, product management, business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
  • Excellent communication skills across all levels of stakeholders - individual contributors to the C-suite; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
  • Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels.
  • Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.

Nice‑to‑have Skills And Experience

  • Experience with open source software and open source business models.
  • Team leadership, product management or program management experience.
  • Understanding of marketing and go-to-market strategy.
  • Sector-specific experience in finance, telecommunications, automotive, or public sectors.
  • Working knowledge of independent hardware and software vendor go-to-market motions.
  • Post‑graduate degree in science, technology or engineering field.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
O Coordenador de Perdas é responsável por identificar, monitorar e implementar estratégias para prevenir perdas, fraudes e riscos operacionais. Atua diretamente na área de Security e Loss Prevention , garantindo a proteção dos ativos da empresa, a integridade das operações logísticas e a segurança de colaboradores e clientes. Este profissional desempenha um papel estratégico na identificação de vulnerabilidades, análise de dados e desenvolvimento de soluções para reduzir perdas financeiras e operacionais, alinhando-se aos valores e objetivos da DeLuna.

Requisitos Técnicos e Comportamentais

Formação Acadêmica:

  • Graduação em Administração, Logística, Gestão de Segurança, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.

  • Experiência prévia em prevenção de perdas, segurança patrimonial ou gestão de riscos em empresas de logística, transporte ou varejo.
  • Conhecimento em operações logísticas (armazenagem, distribuição, transporte).

Competências Técnicas:

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e rastreamento (TMS, WMS, sistemas de CFTV).
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados e auditoria.
  • Domínio do Pacote Office (Excel avançado é um diferencial).
  • Desejável conhecimento em metodologias de investigação e compliance.

Competências Comportamentais:

  • Alta performance: Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e entregar resultados consistentes.
  • Autogerenciamento: Organização e proatividade para lidar com múltiplas demandas.
  • Adaptabilidade: Habilidade para lidar com mudanças e novos desafios.
  • Atitude de dono: Comprometimento com os objetivos da empresa e senso de responsabilidade.
  • Aprendizado contínuo: Interesse em se atualizar sobre novas tecnologias e práticas de prevenção de perdas.

Principais Responsabilidades

Monitoramento e Prevenção de Perdas:

  • Identificar e analisar causas de perdas financeiras, operacionais e de ativos.
  • Implementar políticas e procedimentos para prevenir furtos, extravios, danos e fraudes.
  • Garantir o cumprimento de normas internas de segurança e prevenção de perdas em todas as operações logísticas (First Mile, Middle Mile, Last Mile, etc.).

Análise de Dados e Relatórios:

  • Realizar auditorias e investigações internas para identificar irregularidades e propor melhorias.
  • Monitorar indicadores de performance relacionados a perdas e segurança (KPIs).
  • Elaborar relatórios analíticos e apresentar insights para a liderança, sugerindo ações corretivas e preventivas.

Gestão de Riscos:

  • Mapear vulnerabilidades nos processos logísticos e propor soluções para mitigação de riscos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar planos de contingência e protocolos de segurança.
  • Atuar em parceria com equipes de tecnologia para melhorar sistemas de rastreamento e monitoramento em tempo real.

Treinamento e Conscientização:

  • Capacitar equipes operacionais e administrativas sobre boas práticas de segurança e prevenção de perdas.
  • Promover a cultura de segurança e integridade entre colaboradores e parceiros da DeLuna.

Parcerias e Alinhamento Estratégico:

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com fornecedores, transportadores e clientes para garantir a segurança da cadeia logística.
  • Colaborar com a área de compliance para assegurar que as práticas de prevenção estejam alinhadas às normas regulatórias e aos valores da empresa.

title: Senior Accountant, Accruals & Expenses
description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Job Purpose

The Senior Accountant, Accruals & Expenses, plays a critical role in ensuring the accuracy and integrity of Howard University’s expense‑related financial activities. This position is responsible for reviewing the accounting worktags on invoices, requisitions and other spending; preparing monthly expense accrual entries; analyzing prepaid expenses, expense activity, and reconciling the related general ledger accounts. The Senior Associate partners with Procurement, Accounts Payable, Capital Projects, Budgets and departmental administrators to ensure that expenses are properly recorded in compliance with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), University policy, and internal control standards. This role requires strong analytical capabilities, excellent problem‑solving skills, sound accounting judgment, and the ability to interpret contracts and operational data to determine proper accounting treatment. The Senior Accountant will also support the monthly, quarterly, and annual close and audit processes.

Supervisory Authority

None.

Nature and Scope

Internal contacts include staff within the Controller’s Office, Procurement, Accounts Payable, Budget Office, and departmental administrators, and other departments within the university. External contacts include auditors and consultants.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Review the accounting worktags on new invoices, requisitions and other spending to ensure accurate accounting classification and adequate supporting documentation.
  • Prepare monthly accrual entries across administrative and academic units, ensuring accuracy and compliance with GAAP and University guidelines.
  • Maintain detailed accrual schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
  • Analyze expense trends and variances, propose journal entries, and ensure completeness and accuracy of liabilities.
  • Assist with expense‑related budget vs. actual reviews for the Controller’s Office and institutional departments.
  • Prepare and record prepaid expenses and monthly amortization schedules.
  • Maintain and reconcile prepaid expense ledgers for accuracy and completeness.
  • Ensure prepaid transactions comply with the University’s capitalization and expense recognition policies.
  • Prepare journal entries, reconciliations, roll‑forward schedules, and supporting analytics for monthly close.
  • Perform account analyses to identify errors, omissions, or inconsistencies, recommending corrective actions where needed.
  • Support the preparation of quarterly and annual financial reporting focused on accruals, expenses, and liabilities (i.e. variance analysis).
  • Assist with expense recognition assessments, ensuring appropriate accounting treatment.

Contract & Policy Review

  • Review contracts, agreements, purchase orders, and vendor documentation to interpret accounting implications.
  • Conduct accounting research and prepare clear, concise technical memos documenting decisions in accordance with GAAP/FASB.
  • Ensure adherence to university accounting policies, procurement policies, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Internal Controls, Compliance & Audit Support

  • Ensure accuracy, proper approvals, documentation, and compliance across all expense‑related transactions.
  • Support internal and external audit requests by preparing reconciliations, schedules, and explanations.
  • Help identify gaps in internal controls and suggest improvements to enhance financial accuracy and efficiency.

Collaboration & Cross‑Functional Support

  • Partner with Accounts Payable, Procurement, Capital Projects, Budget, and operational departments to support efficient financial processes.
  • When needed, provide guidance to departments on proper accounting practices, expense classification, and policy interpretation.
  • Assist the Accounting Manager and Assistant Director with special analyses, process improvements, and system initiatives (including Workday enhancements).

Other Duties

  • Perform critical self‑review of work to ensure high quality and accuracy.
  • Support various special projects and other responsibilities as assigned by management.

Core Competencies

  • Strong understanding of GAAP (including accrual accounting and expense recognition)
  • Experience with expense accounting, accruals, reconciliations, and monthly close processes
  • Proficiency with ERP systems (Workday is a plus)
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, data analysis, macros)
  • Exceptional analytical, critical thinking and problem‑solving skills
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines
  • High level of accuracy, organization, and attention to detail

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance
  • Minimum 4–6 years of progressive accounting experience, preferably in a complex environment
  • Experience with accounting for accruals and expenses
  • Workday or large ERP system experience strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work independently, take initiative, and meet strict deadlines.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$105,000-$115,000

description:
The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

The Social Media Strategist plays a critical role in elevating, monitoring, and protecting the Howard University brand across digital platforms. Reporting to the Associate Vice President of Multimedia and Digital Operations in the Office of University Communications (OUC), this position manages the creation and execution of social media calendars, develops content tailored for key audiences, performs social listening and sentiment analysis, and provides governance support for the University’s network of official accounts. This strategist is both a hands‑on creator and a strategic partner, working closely with the office of University of Communication leadership, academic and administrative offices, and digital content teams to ensure consistent storytelling, brand protection, and innovation across platforms.

Supervisory Accountability

May supervise part‑time student employees, fellows, or interns.

Nature And Scope

  • Internal contacts: Campus Partners including faculty, staff, students, administrators
  • External contacts: social media platforms, influencers, media, and the public.

The strategist is expected to operate in a highly visible, high‑volume digital environment while ensuring the University’s online reputation and brand integrity remain strong.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Identify and execute strategies to build Howard University’s visibility and enhance its reputation through innovative use of social platforms.
  • Create and maintain comprehensive social media calendars across flagship channels.
  • Assist with the onboarding of new University social media accounts, ensuring adherence to governance guidelines.
  • Develop, plan, and implement creative programs, campaigns, and engagement strategies to grow audiences and increase impact.
  • Provide timely and accurate social media reporting that highlights KPIs, insights, and recommendations.
  • Support governance tracking, including account audits, policy adherence, and training.
  • Collaborate with Office of University Communications leadership and staff to ensure alignment between institutional priorities and digital storytelling.
  • Recommend new tools, platforms, and technologies (including generative AI) that advance University objectives.
  • Provide training, workshops, or consultative support to internal stakeholders.
  • Manage social communities across all official platforms and foster positive engagement.
  • Support crisis communications management by monitoring trends and providing timely recommendations.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

Knowledge

  • Advanced understanding of major social media platforms, analytics tools, and content formats, with expertise in tailoring content for different audiences.
  • Strong knowledge of online reputation management, governance best practices, and sentiment analysis.
  • Understanding of how generative AI, emerging platforms, and advanced creative tools can be leveraged in higher ed and brand storytelling.

Skills

  • Intermediate to Expert-level proficiency in Canva and strong video editing skills for social platforms (Reels, Shorts, TikTok).
  • Demonstrated ability to design and edit content using professional software (Adobe Premiere, Photoshop, or similar).
  • Strong writing skills with a clear understanding of audience, tone, nuance, and detail (work in multicultural or higher education highly preferred).
  • Creative thinking to help conceptualize campaigns and content that inspire audiences and attract media attention.
  • Strong project management, organization, and reporting skills with a proven ability to juggle multiple deadlines.

Abilities

  • Ability to work under pressure and consistently meet deadlines, including quick‑turn requests.
  • Strong judgment in addressing sensitive issues, crisis situations, and community management.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess social performance, identify opportunities, and deliver actionable insights.
  • Initiative and creativity in generating new content ideas and campaign approaches.
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, highly visible, and fast‑paced digital environment.
  • Results‑oriented, resourceful, and enthusiastic with a proactive, solutions‑first approach.
  • Willingness to work nonstandard hours when required for events, emergencies, or priority campaigns.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Advertising, Public Relations, or a related field.
  • 2–3 years of progressive experience in digital communications, social media management, or online marketing.
  • Required: high-level to expert proficiency in Canva and social-native video editing.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a high-volume environment and manage multiple projects.

Preferred Requirements

  • Hands‑on experience managing a highly active, high‑reach social platform (university, corporate, entertainment, or public figure).
  • Demonstrated knowledge or high interest of generative AI tools and technologies for content creation.
  • Intermediate to advanced skills in higher‑end editing software (Adobe Premiere or similar).
  • Experience with social media scheduling software (Meltwater, Sprout, Hootsuite, Loomly, Later, or similar).
  • Prior social media experience in higher education, large organizations, or public‑facing institutions preferred but not required.

Expected Salary Range: $63,636 - $70,000
